phase3_findings.description: denial_names is built with str(d.get(k,'')) over ('tool','tool_name','name'); if one of those fields holds a non-scalar value containing the token, str() flattens it and re-admits a nested-token false SHIP on the ship-gating (denial) side, partially contradicting the docstring's absolute claim that 'the token nested in a denial's input never falsely gates a SHIP verdict'. Realistic denial shapes keep these fields scalar (the AC's ToolSearch-input-under-'input'-key negative control is handled), so low realizability and non-blocking. Optional hardening: contribute a name only for scalar (str/number) field values.

The third denial-name lookup key 'name' in collect()'s ('tool','tool_name','name') tuple is untested; only 'tool' and 'tool_name' have fixtures. Dropping 'name' from the tuple would leave the suite green. A one-line {"name":"ScheduleWakeup"} -> REMOVED fixture would close it.

Docstring 'Why a helper' paragraph still lists 'the REMOVED single-control fall-through' as a regressable arm; under this change REMOVED is denial-only (elif sw_denied) with no control involvement, so the description is now stale comment-rot.

New schedulewakeup-disable-cron-probe comment's rationale 'set at STEP level ... so a step-level env cannot shadow it inert' is garbled (no coherent same-step shadowing hazard) and mis-attributed to the background-tasks probe, whose own comment gives a different (inertness) rationale. State the real reason (env reaches the claude-code-action process) or align with the sibling.

matcher-probe.yml top-of-file job inventory comment was not updated to list the two added jobs (schedulewakeup-reinvoke-probe, schedulewakeup-disable-cron-probe). Not false (list is non-exhaustive) but incomplete as a job map.

The 'AWAITING RE-MEASUREMENT' block and new-job parentheticals are narrative-heavy (withdrawn run-IDs, false-positive forensics, 'only ever observed locally on 2.1.226') per CLAUDE.md §2.3 comment discipline; run-ID forensics could be trimmed to a pointer while the live 'no flag shipped / awaiting re-measurement' statement stays.

Both new live-probe 'Report execution file' steps print 'execution_file: ' with no distinct breadcrumb when the upstream claude step produced no output, so an operator cannot tell a failed probe from an empty transcript. Advisory only (intended-by-design, gates nothing).
